summary: National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement dated October 16, 2026, for an at-the-market offering of Medium-Term Notes, Series D, under Registration No. 333-299452, on a continuing basis through agents including RBC, BMO, J.P. Morgan, MUFG, PNC, Truist and US Bancorp. Notes mature nine months or more from issuance; a separate pricing supplement sets price, rate and maturity. Agents receive 0.05%-0.875% commissions; direct sales bear no commission. No pricing, size or exchange listing is disclosed. This is routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch actual pricing supplements for terms.
